title: Victoria of Many Faces Season 2, Special Episode Announced
content: Victoria of Many Faces Season 2 and a special episode have been announced. A new visual was also revealed. The first season concluded with nine episodes in total and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Ani-One Asia. Studio DEEN animated the first season with Nobukage Kimura as director.
